title: 思科总裁谈AI进课堂：关键不是用AI，而是保留有效挣扎
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think the most important thing in education is the productive struggle.
segments.zh: 我认为教育中最重要的是有效率的挣扎。

segments.en: And if you all flow that productive struggle to an AI, it's not a great learning experience.
segments.zh: 如果你把这种挣扎交给AI，那并不是好的学习体验。

segments.en: And so what I'm seeing is that educators, first and foremost, the educators need to be educated in how to use AI.
segments.zh: 我看到的是，首先，教育者需要学习如何使用AI。

segments.en: And then the appropriateness per assignment, you know, this assignment, you can have AI do some ideation with you.
segments.zh: 然后根据作业的适当性，比如这个作业，你可以让AI帮你构思。

segments.en: This one you can use it to correct your work. In this case, you shouldn't use AI at all.
segments.zh: 这个可以用AI来纠正你的工作，而这个则完全不应该使用AI。

segments.en: We have to teach both the teachers as well as the students when there's productive struggle and when there's not.
segments.zh: 我们必须教会教师和学生，何时有有效率的挣扎，何时没有。

segments.en: That was McRaw. You'll see Philip Moyer on our show earlier this week discussing AI's influence on education.
segments.zh: 那是麦克劳，你会在本周早些时候看到菲利普·莫耶在我们的节目中讨论AI对教育的影响。
